### DANPRA 59/40 all-day exhibit

At the bell the tape still showed DAN 58/61 and PRA 39/42, the operator's 59/40 all-day shape. Its final named look-alikes were KXATPMATCH-26JUL14VANDAN[CR-4934d8124c1b25f05a34ce965d24b936c73f36ae19c7c755f3ba8cb3040de828] (26JUL; score 0.8178; DAN 42->low 39->close 40, VAN 60->low 59->close 60); KXATPMATCH-26JUL16MOLDAV[CR-835b55c7dabc3c9d08a9b63f3277d3a862f940e5e04f9a759add7098ffaeca50] (26JUL; score 0.8132; MOL 43->low 42->close 42, DAV 59->low 57->close 58); KXATPMATCH-26JUL13TABROD[CR-8f88b0bebbd00e1a430d987173e39dd8efcf6d118eb350b02c695595cbd373ca] (26JUL; score 0.8117; ROD 42->low 40->close 41, TAB 60->low 57->close 60); KXATPMATCH-26JUL17BORDAR[CR-3e15ed9512b1c21eab534ef986c57d6a58d7f35b2d260aaa5025e0f200ce6c88] (26JUL; score 0.8022; BOR 42->low 42->close 43, DAR 59->low 58->close 59); KXATPMATCH-26JUL12MOLROY[CR-4d5208e7085d144581c2646f9a0aa8dc1a2aa5543b3da02c864ca6201029649b] (26JUL; score 0.8004; ROY 41->low 40->close 41, MOL 61->low 59->close 60); KXATPMATCH-26JUL15ETCMER[CR-b6f420f5ac77a93ee0896fd48f81d61b411f329591c3e3e917ef405132f752dd] (26JUL; score 0.7979; MER 40->low 38->close 39, ETC 61->low 59->close 64); KXATPMATCH-26JUL12DZUROC[CR-2208c85f70e26da33eb0d5dc3dc36ddb9ae58aeb1abe9beb70e88f3c3adbba8b] (26JUL; score 0.7960; DZU 44->low 43->close 44, ROC 57->low 55->close 58). Across those games, the high-side anchors near 56–62¢ usually dipped into 42–58¢ before closing 57–65¢, while the low-side anchors near 38–44¢ dipped into 26–44¢ before closing 38–45¢.
